description: IEEE New England 39-bus test case: Dataset for the Transient Stability Assessment is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Petar Sarajcev, Antonijo Kunac (University of Split, FESB). The dataset contains 350 features engineered from the phasor measurements (PMU-type) signals from the IEEE New England 39-bus power system test case network, which are generated from the 9360 systematic MATLAB®/Simulink electro-mechanical transients simulations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
